public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Equilibrium Energy is a Series B climate and energy company founded by Ryan Hanley and Alvin Henrick that has raised $103M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private and 1 public frontier-tech company operating in the same sector and stage range, including KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, Amogy, Helion, and Redwood Materials.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. The stage-progression method uses total capital raised ($103M) as a proxy baseline and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage transitions, implying a valuation of $196M. The peer-median method references three same-sector peers at Series C stage—KoBold Metals ($3.0B), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B), and Amogy ($700M)—yielding a median valuation of $1.0B and a range of $700M to $3.0B.

Triangulating across both methods produces a valuation range of $166M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median estimate of $598M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around stage-appropriate multiples in frontier energy, where Series C peer valuations span nearly 5x. Key sensitivities include the applicability of later-stage peer comparables to a Series B company, capital efficiency relative to peers, and technology risk specific to Equilibrium's core thesis.
